examples.note: Dear Prescriber, I am the dispensing pharmacist for a shared patient (40-44, male). Levodopa and decarboxylase inhibitor 300 mg was started 22 days after Metoclopramide 15 mg. This is a possible prescribing cascade. Suspected reaction: possible drug-induced parkinsonism. Evidence: listed in Classic cascade (source not yet verified); population signal aSR 23.5 (CI 8.9–87.9). Thank you for considering this. Could you please review whether Levodopa and decarboxylase inhibitor 300 mg is treating a side-effect of Metoclopramide 15 mg?

examples.note: Dear Prescriber, I am writing to bring to your attention a possible prescribing cascade. The patient was prescribed Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg on [index_drug] and Allopurinol 300 mg on [marker_drug] with a gap of 41 days. This may be related to Gout / hyperuricaemia, as per the PSSA literature (source not yet verified). I would appreciate it if you could review this combination and consider the potential implications. Please review.
examples.reaction_description: The patient, a female aged 65-69, experienced Gout / hyperuricaemia possibly related to the concomitant use of Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg and Allopurinol 300 mg, 41 days apart.

examples.note: Dear Prescriber, I am the dispensing pharmacist for a shared patient (80-84, female). Furosemide 40 mg was started 58 days after Pregabalin 150 mg, by a different prescriber. This is a possible prescribing cascade. Suspected reaction: possible oedema. Evidence: listed in ThinkCascades (source not yet verified); population signal aSR 14.1 (CI 6.9–33.4).
